 Markets Indian stocks stage rapid rebound as AI hedge accelerates
 US midterm results and falling oil prices attract nearly $9 billion in foreign investor inflow
 Foreign investors are taking a fresh look at Indian stocks, which had been sold off because of concerns over AI headwinds. © Reuters
 JADA NAGUMO November 17, 2026 10:21 JST Updated on November 17, 2026 15:37 JST TOKYO -- Indian stocks are surging on falling oil prices and a global rotation away from AI-related shares, helping drive foreign investor inflows into the market.
